entities.summary: Trevor Vaughan Gott is an American professional baseball pitcher in the Washington Nationals organization. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Los Angeles Angels of Anaheim, the Nationals, San Francisco Giants, Milwaukee Brewers, Seattle Mariners, and New York Mets.
